marcia.text: The allotments passed another inspection. The minutes are available. The interesting part is not in the minutes.
Fourteen years as secretary and I still can't get anyone to read the agenda before the meeting.
Something is growing under plot 31 that I did not plant. I am being very calm about it.
Compost is a long game. So, as it turns out, is most of what I do.
Reminder that a hosepipe ban is a suggestion to people who don't know where the standpipe is.
Open to discreet horticulture. Discretion is the whole job.

tomasz.text:
I was told networking is how people find work.

So. Hello.

I am Tomasz.
I do cultivating.

That is the post.

I am meant to post three times a week.

This is one.

Will post again in 2 days.

Someone advised me to share a lesson.

Lesson: a vein left alone does not stay alone.
It drifts. Check on it.

I hope that was useful.
I am told these should end with a question.

Was it useful?

variants.eager:
Someone advised me to share a lesson.

Lesson: a vein left alone does not stay alone.
It drifts. Check on it.

I hope that was useful.
I am told these should end with a question.

Was it useful? I have eleven more. I will do them tomorrow, at five.

tomasz.text:
Went to a networking event.

Stood near the biscuits for forty minutes.
Spoke to one man.
He was also near the biscuits.

We are now connected.

I think that went well.

Please like this post.

I read that it helps.
I do not know who it helps.

Thank you.

Passionate. Driven. Results-oriented.

I copied these from someone's profile.
I am not sure what the results are.

I am mainly into veins. And videogames.

#Growth

Spent the morning with a flourishing vein.

Best morning this week.

I should say something about leadership here.
The vein did not lead.
It was just there.

variants.eager:
Spent the morning with a flourishing vein.

Best morning of my life. I am going back tomorrow.

I should say something about leadership here.
The vein did not lead.
It was just there.

tomasz.text:
Updated my profile photo.

The old one was me and the van.
Advice was: no van.

The new one is me, no van.
The van is just out of frame.
It is not happy.

Hi all.

Apparently you are meant to say you are "thrilled" when making a post here.

Feels a bit strong, tbh. I am pleased, maybe. Wouldn't go further than that

Reached out to a stranger today, as advised.

Message: "Hello, I would like to connect."
Reply: nothing.

I think that is how it works.
I will do it again tomorrow.

variants.eager:
Reached out to a stranger today, as advised.

Message: "Hello, I would like to connect."
Reply: nothing.

I think that is how it works.
I will do it again tomorrow. And six more this afternoon, if the van starts.

tomasz.text:
What is your five-year plan?

Mine is a vein that stays strong
without anyone checking on it.

I realise this is not a career goal.
It is still my plan.

I was told to build my brand.

I do not have a brand. I have boots.

They are good boots. Resoled once.

Let me know if you want to hear more about the boots.

Posted nothing yesterday.
Felt guilty about it all day.
Posted nothing the day before too.

This is called consistency. Not the good kind.

variants.eager:
Posted nothing yesterday.
I was pruning.

I am told pruning is not content.
I am told a lot of things.

tomasz.text:
Someone commented "Great insights."

I went back and read the post.
I could not find the insights.

I thanked them anyway.

Day 3 of trying to find the "like" button
on my own post.

I have been told by some people that you can like your own post. Some have told me you can't

I don't get this app.

I cannot tell whether anyone reads these.

If you do: hello.
If you need a person who turns up at five
and does not complain: hello again.

Someone asked what I do in my free time.

I said I read about growth bands.

The room went quiet. Later a man said it was an interesting answer.

I do not think it was a compliment.

bernie.text: Somebody's endorsed me for "synergy". Is that another one of these apps?
Lad at work said I should be on here. I'm on here. What now.
Pressed a button. It said "Post". Well, that's done.
Phone says someone viewed my profile. Hope they try other angles. Left side's my good one.
Somebody's asked me to "share my journey". Bus, then Victoria line. Both were late.
Someone's written "congrats" under my last post. For what. Nothing happened.
Some guy on this app is going on about how his hangnail taught him about overcoming adversity. Don't get it, myself. Mine just hurt.
Notification says someone's completed a marathon. Dunno why they're telling me. I don't watch sports.
Woman on the 54 gave up her seat to a wee lad with a cello. Good woman. Anyway, the bus was late.
Bloke down the road fixed a neighbour's gate without being asked. Never got his name. Hope he's well.
Kid in the café got my order right first time. Said nothing. Just got it right. Rare.
Asked about my five-year plan. Same as the last eight.
Mug's moved again. Nobody's saying anything. Fine.
replies: Found it exactly where I left it. Suspicious in itself.

bernie.text: Need a good plumber, SE15. Blocked toilet.

replies.text: Try Raymond. Drains, boilers, the odd miracle. Reference may be a different Ray.

replies: Thanks. First one's a man called Raymond. Do I want Raymond.

replies.text: Delighted to offer a free consultation on your blockage. Retainer rates on request. #Plumbing #BilledToTheMinute

replies: Is this sponsored. I want a good plumber, not an ad.

replies.text: Check the fall on the pipe. Check who fitted it. Check the certificate.

replies: I only wanted the one plumber. Not forty opinions.

replies.text: Blocked usually means stressed. Poultice for that. Also gin.

replies: Don't recall asking what's wrong with me. Just the plumber.

saoirse.text: Left the Collective on good terms. Mostly. Ask me about the awkward seam in Peckham, I have a lot to say about

variants.distracted: Left the Collective on good terms. Mostly. Ask me about the awkward seam in Peckham, which reminds me, did I ever tell you about Lisbon

saoirse.text: Six years growing for other people. Wondering what it's like to grow for a reason.
Good with the awkward ones. The seams, I mean. People are a separate skill.
Nearly went to Lisbon once. The ferry was lovely. I was not on it.

variants.distracted: Nearly went to Lisbon once. The ferry was lovely. Anyway what was I posting. Lisbon. The ferry.

saoirse.text: Co-operatives are just committees that remember each other's birthdays.
Mostly on good terms with everyone. That is a real sentence I wrote.

priya.text: Signed something once. Cannot discuss what. Can discuss the paperwork, which was immaculate.
Stress load tested a thing today. The thing held. The thing's origin did not come up.
Formerly of a firm. The firm is not on the list of places I have been.
Materials don't lie. Certificates do. I keep both.
Open to work that involves measuring things. Open to not asking what they are.

dot.text: Market stall, Deptford, Saturdays. Tinctures, poultices, no refunds on heartbreak.
My remedy for heartbreak is mostly gin. The rest is honesty about the gin.
Someone asked for a poultice for a haunted knee. Did it. Knee seems happy.
Saturdays only, unless you're paying. Which you should be.
Good to see the paperwork hold up. Mine never does.
Open to work. Bring your own jar.

gideon.text:
I'm humbled to announce
that I have raised my rates.

Not because I had to.
Because the minute demanded it.

Some will say a minute is a minute.
Those people have never been billed by me.

#Humbled #Craft #BilledToTheMinute

My apprentice asked for a lunch break today.

I gave him one.
Twelve minutes.
I timed it. He thanked me.

Seven years in, he finally understands the value of time.
Seven years in, he is still my apprentice.
Both of these are growth.

Repost if your mentor has ever invoiced you for it.

#Mentorship #Patience #GuildLife

Coffee with a prospective client this morning.

25 minutes.
£40 for the meeting.
£12 for the coffee.
£3 for the silence.

They said yes.

Your silence has a rate.
Most people give it away for free.

Thoughts?

#Negotiation #TimeIsMoney #NeverDiscount

Eleven years ago I was a nobody in Clerkenwell.

Today I turn away more work before breakfast than most people accept all week.

Never forget where you started.

I am humbled. I am also booked until March.

#Clerkenwell #Grind

Turned down a £2,000 commission today.

The client wanted it "quickly".
I do not do quickly. I do precisely.

Quickly is precisely, with regret.

#Standards #Craft #NoRegrets

Missed my train this morning.
By eleven seconds.

Did I blame the train? No.
Did I blame the platform? No.
I blamed the eleven seconds.
I am now billing them.

Failure is just a client you haven't invoiced yet.

Agree?

People keep asking if I'm hiring.

I'm not.

I'm curating a very small number of people
who will never be as good as me.

It's called a team.

#Leadership #Hiring #Standards

Humbled to be named "Most Billed" in my field.

By me.
In my own ledger.
Three years running.

Nobody else was nominated.
That is what excellence looks like from the inside.

#Humbled #Awards #Excellence

Got my first negative review today.

"Too expensive."

I read it twice.
Then I raised my rates.

Feedback is a gift. 
Mine is £90 an hour.

#Feedback #Growth #Rates

Someone asked what the Guild taught me.

Patience.
Discretion.
How to look at a thing most people can't look at without sitting down.

And always invoice before the screaming starts.

Thoughts?

#GuildLife #Lessons

I wake at 4:11am.

Not 4:10.
Not 4:12.

At 4:10 the day isn't ready.
At 4:12 I am already behind.

Winners don't set alarms.
Alarms are set by winners.

What time do YOU wake? Comment below.

#Routine #Mindset

A client haggled me down £50 yesterday.

I let her.
Then I took £50 of minutes off the end of the job.
She didn't notice.
She will.

Negotiation was never about money.
It's about whose minutes they are.

#Negotiation #Minutes

Took a day off yesterday.

Seven hours.
Billed to myself.
At my day rate.

My accountant says that isn't how it works.
My accountant is no longer my accountant.

Self-care is an invoice you pay yourself.

#SelfCare #Boundaries

Quick poll.

What is the most valuable thing you own?

A) Your time
B) My time
C) Both, mostly mine

Comment below. I will be timing the replies.

#Poll #Engagement

Unpopular opinion:

Punctuality is not a virtue.
It is the bare minimum.

I arrive early.
Then I wait outside until the minute is correct.
Then I enter.
Then I bill for the waiting.

#UnpopularOpinion #Punctuality

5 things I learned from 11 years of invoicing by the minute:

1. Minutes add up.
2. Nobody reads the terms.
3. I wrote the terms.
4. Everyone reads the total.
5. The total was also me.

Save this post.
I will know if you didn't.

#Lessons #Invoicing

A stranger on the Central line asked what I do.

I said: "I bill people for time they didn't know they had."

She moved seats

That's called disruption.

#Disruption #Tube

Queued at Pret for 6 minutes today.

I did not complain.
I did not sigh.
I sent the barista an invoice for the 6 minutes.

She has not responded.
She will.

Be the change you wish to be paid for.

#Pret #Resilience

Thrilled to announce I've been invited to a Guild dinner.

I will not be speaking.
I will be seated near the front
so that others are reminded I am there.
The Guild don't know it yet, but I will arrive
early and sit down before anyone else does.

Presence is a keynote.

#Humbled #Guild #Visibility

Today I want to thank the person who believed in me when nobody else did.

Me.
On a Tuesday.
In 2014.

You can't pour from an empty cup.
You can, however, invoice from one.

#Gratitude #Belief

My nephew asked me what time is.

I said: "Time is the only thing they can't take from you."
He said: "Who is they?"
I said: "My clients. Sit down."

He's 7.
He's already in my diary.

#Family #Legacy

Received a CV with a typo today.

Interviewed the candidate anyway.
Told him the typo cost me 9 seconds.
He offered to pay it.

I did not hire him.
But he understood the invoice.

That's rare.

#Hiring #Standards

I cried at work today.

Not from stress.
Not from sadness.
From the beauty of a perfectly completed invoice.

Itemised.
Rounded down.

Vulnerability is a strength.

#Vulnerability #Authenticity

Monday doesn't scare me.

I've billed Monday.
Monday owes me.
Monday knows it.

Some people dread the start of the week.
I send it a reminder.

#MondayMotivation #Grind

They say "quiet quitting".

I say "loud billing".

The difference is a receipt.

Repost if you have ever been loud about it.

#Hustle #LoudBilling

A competitor copied my rate card today.

Word for word.
Including the typo.
Especially the typo.

The typo is a trap.
It costs £15 to fall into.
He has already fallen.

#Competition #Strategy

My most loyal client has never paid an invoice.

Not once.
Eleven years.

I keep sending them.
She keeps reading them.

That's not debt.
That's a relationship.

(It is also £14,000.)

#Loyalty #Relationships

People ask how I balance work and life.

I don't.
I bill both.

Work: billed.
Life: billed at 1.5x.
Sleep: billed at a rate I won't discuss.

#WorkLifeBalance #Boundaries

This meeting could have been an email.

It was an email.
I attended anyway.
To bill for the meeting about the email.

Efficiency is a mindset.

#Meetings #Efficiency

It rained on my walk to a client this morning.

Some see rain.
I saw eleven extra minutes of travel,
billable at the wet rate.

There is no bad weather.
Only unbilled weather.

#Mindset #Resilience

Radical transparency.

My rate is £90 an hour.
My real rate is £90 an hour,
plus a rate for explaining the rate.

I'm told that isn't transparency.
I'm told a lot of things.
By people without a ledger.

#Transparency #Honesty

500 connections!

I'd like to thank each of you individually.
This will take about three hours.
You will receive an invoice.

#Milestone #Grateful

I failed once.

2009. A commission arrived a day late.
Nobody has ever spoken of it.
I made sure.

Failure is a gift.
Mine was wrapped and sent somewhere it won't be found.

#Failure #Growth

Re-read my post from last Tuesday.

Still brilliant.
Reposting it for the people
who weren't ready the first time.

They weren't ready the first three times either.

#Reposting #Content

ray.text: Jack of all trades. Ask around. Not all of them will say good things.

variants.distracted: Jack of all trades. Ask around. Not all of them will say good things. Where was I. Trades.

ray.text: Done a bit of everything. Some of it twice. The second time went better.

variants.distracted: Turns up. Usually. Today I turned up at the wrong depot but it was a nice depot.

ray.text: Fate, emotion, time. I dabble. Dabbling has a rate.
Reference available on request. Reference may be a different Ray.
Open to anything with a van. Or a bike. Or a very determined walk.

comments.text: Good to hear the paperwork held.
Tell me more when you can.
I know someone who can help with that.
Interesting. Don't put that in writing again.
That explains the noise last Tuesday.
Thanks for sharing. Please stop sharing.
